column4: Mabotuwana  Sri  Piyarathana  Nayaka  Thero
Suwasevana  Foundation  (Incorporation)
to  give  temporary  residential  facilities  to  patients
from  various  areas  of  Sri  Lanka  suffering  from
dreadful  non  –  communicable  diseases  to  the
Karapitiya Hospital for treatment;
to operate a day care Centre for disabled and back -
ward children;
to  operate  a  library  for  making  available  library
facilities for the mental comfort of residents;
to provide the residents with a meal prepared in a
safe manner and according to proper standard free
of charge;
to provide each patient facilities separately, such as
fridges  necessary  to  properly  store  medicines  etc,
that  should  be  administered  daily  to  patients  and
operating a support service to give each patient the
prescribed  doses  of  medicine  at  the  specrified
time;
to provide free accommodation facilities to relatives,
friends or acquaintances accompanying patients and
providing them with meals free of charge;
to  provide  financial  aid  in  the  case  of  poor  and
helpless  patients  who  cannot  afford  the  medicine
prescribed to them; and
to act in cooperation with local and foreign people
and  organizations  who  are  willing  to  work  for
helpless  patients.
